entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your form flexes and contorts in unexpected ways, making it difficult for enemies to move you against your will.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Style, base attack bonus +5, change shape ability, shapechanger subtype.

Benefit(s): While you are using Shapeshifter Style, you gain a +2 bonus to your CMD versus bull rush, drag, grapple, overrun, reposition, and trip combat maneuvers. If you begin your turn with the grappled condition, you can attempt a combat maneuver check or an Escape Artist check as a move action to attempt to break the grapple.

Special: A character with the wild shape class feature counts as having the change shape ability and shapechanger subtype for the purpose of meeting this feat’s prerequisites.
